title: New worlds to explore with Starfield Creations!
raw: [p]From new factions and new planetary locations, to new companions with different playstyles. Cruise into these Starfield Creations and add another layer to your Starborn's universe! [/p][p][/p][h1][u]Factions and Stories[/u][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Watchtower: Orbital.Strike\\\\Fleet.Command[/h2][p][i]by Kinggath_Creations[/i][/p][previewyoutube="_AUNVb3Jvyo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Gather your crew, build your fleet, and take the fight to [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/5d455df7-d99f-4619-a383-f2b39aa21e00/Watchtower__Orbital_Strike__Fleet_Command"]Watchtower[/url]. A new faction has emerged from the shadows to protect humanity from potential threats with excessive power - and they’ve identified YOU as their latest target. [/p][list][*][p]New Storyline - Join forces with a fellow adventurer hunted by Watchtower, befriend their contacts, and work together to pilfer Watchtower’s technology and turn it against them - as Watchtower has done to the threats they hunt. [/p][/*][*][p]Build a Fleet - Crew all of your ships and have them fight beside you in space, provide planetary support with orbital strikes, and help protect you from the growing threat that is Watchtower.[/p][/*][*][p]Strike from Above - Unlock powerful new ship attachments known as Skydrops which allow your fleet to provide support drops or rain down attacks from orbit to help you as you adventure planet-side.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Redgrave [/h2][p][i]by TheMilkArtist[/i] [/p][previewyoutube="tADBLrkaEfA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/8d465f06-528d-4f47-9a69-052350533bb1/Redgrave"]Redgrave[/url] takes you to a struggling upstart LIST colony on a distant world. As one of its earliest allies, you help recruit new settlers, and watch the settlement rise from bare foundations into a functioning community. Along the way, you help uncover the aftermath of an ancient disaster and a long-forgotten people.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Sammy and the Lab of Nightmares[/h2][p][i]by Adam Dunmer[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623050/1bbaf85de163cbe8879f0c928947b11b94defdf6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623050/d139a3a5f62c21cae0b7a36aef50d1d8f6791e75.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/starfield/details/91bc2fcd-37dd-417d-b2d6-54e793a001e6/Sammy_and_the_Lab_of_Nightmares"]Join a whole new faction[/url], Xenobiology Research Wing DC-29, in "Sammy and the Lab of Nightmares"! Experience the world of black market Xeno-Sciences with 8 new quests, over ten new locations, over 2,200 lines of dialogue across 70+ unique NPCS (voiced by an international cast comprised of 17 professional voice actors), and a whole new companion - Sammy! Delve into long-forgotten caves, explore a research campus chockful of peculiar inhabitants, roleplay to your heart's content, and sink your teeth into this new satirical, lighthearted adventure approximately 5-6 hours in length.[/p][p][/p][h2]Cryomancer
